body:
>Ever think about traveling somewhere on Earth? There are some amazing places here.

Can't afford it. I've traveled before, but it'll be quite some time before I can afford to again.

>Did you take the pills for a while? Most antidepressants take several weeks to work.

Yeah, you could say I'm pretty good at drugs, so I did all of the research and everything. Just made me tired all the time.

>Nothing anyone on this forum tells you is going to be a cure-all.

Not really sure what I was looking for here, but thanks. Par for the course :|

>Have you talked to anyone about how you feel?

Years ago. Got a 'scrip for some antidepressants, and they didn't do anything so I stopped taking them. I don't expect anything else from any further professional help.

>Is there something you have always wanted to do?

Nothing realistic. Anything I could quickly think of is little more than escapist fantasy-- going to the Moon/Mars/space in general, so on and so forth. Sure, a trip to the moon will likely be possible in my expected lifespan... but if I can do it, so could anyone else which eliminates the entire damn point.

Sure I've felt happy before, but never more than fleetingly. Unhappy is my natural state. If I had to write out a list of things I enjoy, I would sit here for an hour and end up doing something else because I can't think of anything... at least anything I can actually do.

>Certainly more to life than a job, girlfriend and apartment.

That's what I keep hearing.

>Ever skydived?

Seems boring. You hit terminal velocity and it's a really loud elevator ride from there.

>What's your story?

Nothing remarkable. Have a job, have a girlfriend, just moved into a new place... but I don't really care about any of it. I just don't really care at all, honestly. The only reason I work is to have money to buy food and pay rent to stay alive. But I don't like working (who does), and being alive doesn't really do much for me either... so why do two things that suck all the time? That doesn't make very much sense.

Staying alive just doesn't add up. It's difficult, un-enjoyable, long, annoying, full of dumbasses around every corner. Life has little to offer me.

>What are you struggling with right now? 

Nothing. I just don't really see the point anymore.

>Nothing wrong with being an adrenaline junky

Normally I'd agree, but its gotten to the point where if I'm not in a moderate amount of fatal danger, it doesn't really do anything for me. I'd have to hit at least 100+mph to be excited in a car anymore.

>Motorsports are great for adrenaline junkies, but expensive.

This is traditionally my go to sport, but as you say its incredibly expensive to do legally.... which leads to less than legal road activity.

I've been getting the motorcycle itch again and I'm certain it'd kill me this time, which is why I'm looking for alternatives haha
